bagPolicy.summary: State Farm Center enforces a clear-bag and prohibited-items policy. Guests should bring only a policy-compliant clear bag or approved small personal item.
prohibited: Items listed as prohibited by the arena
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking surrounds the arena in multiple lot quadrants. Guests should use the official parking map and event instructions for the assigned area.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
